title: A bank account class
description:
Write a class that keeps its balance safe.

```
Ada: 100.00
Deposit 50.00 -> 150.00
Withdraw 500.00 refused: only 150.00 available
Accounts opened: 2
```
hints: `private static int opened = 0;` belongs to the class, not to one account; increase it in the constructor (lesson 3.02).
requirements: `private` fields, a constructor, getters, and `deposit` and `withdraw` methods that return `false` when refused.
stretch: Add `transfer(Account to, double amount)` that does nothing at all if the withdrawal is refused.
